text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I'm shaking! This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I'm shaking! This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to compete with me? I'm
the one
who should be happy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I won't ruin it for you this time.
Seeing you
happy makes me excited!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What? It's not like I want to be shaking.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I know. You mean I'll feel even
more
excited.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And yeah, I think so too. I want to win
more!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wild. I'm already so excited about the
next race. I
hope you'll pick me out a
good one!
